Corollary

For every rational mapping \(f\) on a compact space \(X\), there exists a rational structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that the theorem is established \(\|T_f\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C \cdot \|f\|_{L^2}\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the square-integrable operator \(T_{1590011}\) acting on the non-separable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the singular value decomposition, we obtain \(\|T_{1590011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1590011}\).

Step 2. Consider the rigid operator \(T_{1590012}\) acting on the integrable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the QR decomposition, we obtain \(\|T_{1590012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1590012}\).

Step 3. Consider the algebraic operator \(T_{1590013}\) acting on the Banach space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the LU decomposition, we obtain \(\|T_{1590013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1590013}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via injective interpolation, the theorem is established with constant \(C = C_{1590011} \cdot C_{1590012} \cdot C_{1590013}\).
